pay.heading: Pay with a QR code
pay.instructions: Open your banking app (or Revolut), choose scan-to-pay and scan the code. The amount of {{amount}} and the payment reference are pre-filled — just confirm.
pay.referenceWarning: If you pay manually, enter the payment reference exactly as shown — it is how we match your order.
pay.autoRefresh: This updates by itself as soon as the payment arrives.
pay.reload: Reload the page to see the latest payment status.

received.heading: Payment received
received.body: Your bank has sent the money. Confirmation usually follows within seconds.
received.review: Your bank has sent the money. A first payment from a new account may be reviewed, usually for a few minutes and rarely for a few hours. No need to pay again.

underpaid.heading: A smaller amount arrived
underpaid.body: Your payment arrived but is less than the order total. The merchant will contact you.

rejected.heading: Payment failed
rejected.body: The payment was rejected and the money is being returned to your account. Contact the merchant to try again.

expired.heading: This QR code has expired
expired.body: The payment window for this order has closed. Contact the merchant if you still want it.

unavailable.heading: QR payment is not available right now
unavailable.body: We cannot issue a QR code for this order. Contact the merchant for other ways to pay.
